Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

Patients can receive various types of discounts during the billing process. These include user-wise limit discounts and date-wise discounts. If a billing user has the necessary privileges, they can apply discounts directly on the billing screen, adhering to the limits set for that user. Additionally, if there are any date-wise discounts applicable to a patient for specific services, those can also be applied. To apply a discount profile to a patient's bill, the user must select the relevant details from the 'Reference' field and click the 'Apply' button, which will automatically apply the discount to the bill.

which field is used to specifie insurance complany name?

The field used to specify the insurance company name is labeled as 'Insurance.' This field allows for a searchable selection of the insurance company. ![Insurance Company Field](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_112817.png)
